name: Wilfa Svart Uniform
details: Electric flat-burr grinder with 41 numbered settings.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 1, espresso 1–9, moka pot 9–23, AeroPress 7–38, V60 11–25, filter coffee machine 6–35, French press 25–41, cold brew 31–41. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. For the stock burrs.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
